sentences.text: Aliaume Damala Badara Akon Thiam -LRB- born April 16 , 1973 -RRB- , better known as Akon -LRB- pronounced -LSB- ˈeɪkɒn -RSB- -RRB- , is an American singer , rapper , songwriter , businessman , record producer and actor of Senegalese descent .	songwriter	songwriter	rapper	rapper	record producer	record producer	actor	actor
He rose to prominence in 2004 following the release of `` Locked Up '' , the first single from his debut album Trouble .	Locked Up	Locked Up (song)	Trouble	Trouble (Akon album)
He has since founded two successful record labels , Konvict Muzik and Kon Live Distribution .	Konvict Muzik	Konvict Muzik	Kon Live	Kon Live Distribution	Kon Live Distribution	Kon Live Distribution

His second album , Konvicted received three nominations for the Grammy Awards in two categories , Best Contemporary R&B Album for Konvicted album and Best Rap/Sung Collaboration for `` Smack That '' and `` I Wan na Love You '' .	R&B	Contemporary R&B	Konvicted	Konvicted	Best Contemporary R&B Album	Best Contemporary R&B Album	Best Rap/Sung Collaboration	Best Rap/Sung Collaboration	Smack That	Smack That	Grammy Awards	Grammy Awards
He is the first solo artist to hold both the number one and two spots simultaneously on the Billboard Hot 100 charts twice .
Akon has had four songs certified as 3 × platinum , three songs certified as 2 × platinum , more than ten songs certified as 1 × platinum and more than ten songs certified as gold in digital sales .
Akon has sung songs in other languages including Tamil , Hindi , and Spanish .	Tamil	Tamil language	Hindi	Hindi	Spanish	Spanish language
He was listed by the Guinness Book of World Records as the # 1 selling artist for master ringtones in the world .
Akon often provides vocals as a featured artist and is currently credited with over 300 guest appearances and more than 35 Billboard Hot 100 songs .	vocals	vocals

He has worked with numerous performers such as Michael Jackson , Eminem , Snoop Dogg , Whitney Houston , Bone Thugs-N-Harmony , and Gwen Stefani .
